faq_heading: Tsawwassen North condos and townhomes: your questions answered

faq.q: What did condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen North sell for?
faq.a: 40 condos sold in Tsawwassen North between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $502,960.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Tsawwassen North?
faq.a: The median was 29 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (2% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen North sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 40 condos that sold in Tsawwassen North went for between $378,750 and $663,750, around a median of $502,960.

faq.q: Do condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen North sell above asking price?
faq.a: 2% of the 40 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.1% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen North?
faq.a: Of the 40 sales, 40 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $484.

faq.q: How old are the condos and townhomes that sold in Tsawwassen North?
faq.a: The median year built was 2021 for the 40 condos sold in Tsawwassen North.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos and townhomes in Tsawwassen North usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Tsawwassen North had 2 bedrooms, from the 40 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Tsawwassen North condos and townhomes sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

40 condos sold in Tsawwassen North with a median price of $502,960 (the middle half sold between $378,750 and $663,750), taking a median of 29 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 2% sold above list. They had a median $711 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $484 a month. 39 townhomes sold in Tsawwassen North with a median price of $739,000 (the middle half sold between $692,500 and $844,500), taking a median of 41 days to sell at 97.9% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $541 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $388 a month.

blocks.text: How Tsawwassen North compares with the rest of Tsawwassen

The median condo in Tsawwassen North sold for $502,960, 14% below the Tsawwassen median of $585,000 across 97 sales. Tsawwassen North condos took a median 29 days to sell, against 44 days for Tsawwassen as a whole.
